Forn Vell
BreadHoursVisit

Oven lit at five

A wood-fired bakery on Carrer Major since 1932. Loaves leave the oven at seven and are gone by noon.

Reserve a loaf

Four loaves, every morning

  • Country sourdough, 1 kg: 6.50 €
  • Rye with caraway, 800 g: 5.80 €
  • Spelt and honey, 700 g: 5.40 €
  • Olive and rosemary, 600 g: 4.90 €
  • Coca de recapte, by the slice: 3.20 €
  • Ensaïmada, on Sundays: 2.80 €

Flour from the Molí d'en Pau, ground the week it is baked. Water from the town well, salt from the Delta.

Open six mornings a week

Tuesday to Sunday, 7:00 to 13:00. Closed on Mondays and through August, when the oven is relined.

Find the green door

Carrer Major 14, next to the church steps. Ring the bell if the door is shut; someone is always at the oven.
